desc:
Welcome to the Ragdoll Test Lab! You're the tester. Grab a crash test dummy and see what happens.

🧪 TEST STATIONS: throw a dummy through glass, into a hoop and down a bowling lane, or drop a piano on one. Beat today's best.
🚀 CRASH TEST: launch a dummy down the track and into the net.
🩻 BODY MAP: every bump and broken bone lights up as it happens.
🧲 PHYSICS GUN: grab anything, freeze it mid-air, grow it 6x and throw it.
🔧 TOOL GUN: ropes, balloons and thrusters.
🚓 LAB CITY: a town that falls apart, with police and SWAT dummies behind riot shields.
💥 BOOM: grenades, barrels and rockets.
🚗 RIDE: a buggy, motorbike, helicopter and tank.
🪐 GRAVITY: from floating to double heavy.
🩺 DOCTOR KIT: patch them up and test again.
📖 CODEX: 75 things to find out.
👥 CO-OP: bring friends into your lab.

⭐ EARN EVERY TOOL BY PLAYING.

1-7 tools · B build · L lab · U unlocks · C fly · J revive all
